comparisons.caveat: Descriptive paired difference (treatment minus baseline), 10000 seeded bootstrap samples of family clusters. Repeated attempts are averaged within case. The evaluated templated families are a small correlated sample; the interval does not establish population capability. Configured-system comparisons can vary model and effort together and cannot establish a pure effort effect. Clean contrasts exclude output truncation.
comparisons.intervalMetric: weighted diagnostic delta; no separate headline interval
comparisons.additionalCaveat: Three correlated single-attempt anchors; descriptive bootstrap has weak power and cannot establish population ranking or localize frontier50–60.

limitations: Development-only native artifacts; no held-out outputs read.
Three equally weighted single-attempt correlated families yield33.33point headline steps; no localized50–60 target or population confidence claim.
Fact and evidence criteria share correctness dependencies; structural handoff does not certify semantic facts/request correctness.
Raw criterion failures are not yet an independently accepted paid failure audit; semantic versus measurement/protocol causes require trace review.
Token-rate cost estimates are not invoices or shared-ledger reservation balances.
Weighted case wins/ties and clustered intervals differ from macro whole-task success; retain both.
